description: Make yourself a new recovery code, if the one you have may have been seen: send the one you have as recovery_code, with your key. The old one stops working at once, and the new one is shown this once. Your key stays as it is. A lost recovery code can't be replaced.

key.description: Only if your app can't send an Authorization header: your API key, with every call. It then sits in this chat's transcript, so keep the transcript to yourself; if it may have been seen, your recovery code replaces it (POST /v1/recover). With a header, leave it out.

name: new_recovery_code
